what: The first public deployment of PathAble: the Waterloo pilot on one OVH VPS, built from nothing on 2026-10-14/15. Every figure below was measured on that host or against its public address during the deployment; none is estimated. Procedure in docs/deployment/VPS.md, decision in ADR 0009.

deployed_revision.is: main after PR #90 (the PA-GEO-09 merge), unmodified
deployed_revision.images: pathable-api and pathable-web tagged with the full SHA, built on the host from `git archive` of it, OCI revision label set

deployment_tooling: infra/vps/ on branch ops/vps-deploy (PR #102); the application images contain none of it

host.disk: 38 GB root; 14 GB used after the deployment, mostly images and build cache

tls.issuer: Let's Encrypt YE1, profile shortlived (the only one that issues for an IP address)
tls.fault_found: Verifying clients send no SNI to an IP address; inside Docker the connection's local address is the container's, so Caddy found no certificate and sent a TLS internal-error alert. Fixed with default_sni. Before the fix only `openssl s_client -servername 51.222.36.79` (an IP in SNI, which RFC 6066 forbids) completed a handshake; after it, Windows schannel and OpenSSL both verify.

second_revision_465bab7_while_serving.note: web came from build cache: apps/ is identical between the two commits

archive.source: data-only pg_dump of the local production-smoke database, which holds the verified dataset at migration 0007

content_checksum.then: recorded with `pathable datasets checksum --record`, and verified again: matches

api_cold_start.how: infra/vps/measure.sh 3: force-recreate the API container alone, poll /health/live and /health/ready through `docker exec` every 0.25 s, host clock; then 30 s settle and the container's cgroup memory
api_cold_start.breakdown_run_3: 9.1 s for the previous API process to exit after SIGTERM (exit 0, not killed); 4 s entrypoint (database wait, migrations at head); 3.5 s imports; 33.6 s graph load. From the new container's start to ready: 41.7 s
api_cold_start.against_the_laptop: PA-RR-03 measured 18.7 s to ready and a 14.6 s graph load on the laptop (production-envelope.json); this 2-vCPU host loads the same graph in about 34 s

db.note: cgroup figures include page cache; the peak is from the 22 s restore and two checksum reads

smoke.script: infra/vps/smoke.py, 16 checks; exits non-zero on any failure

runs.from: the founder's laptop over the public internet
the VPS itself, through Caddy on the public address
the founder's laptop over the public internet

smoke.journey: Davis Centre Library to Student Life Centre, both found by place search: shortest 406.4 m with 4 stairways, wheelchair 490.2 m with 0, dataset 51585450, ml_predictions_used false — identical to docs/evidence/waterloo-place-search.json

browser.suite: apps/web playwright.fullstack.config.ts with FULLSTACK_TARGET=compose against https://51.222.36.79, Chromium, from the laptop
browser.first_run: 15 passed, 2 failed. Both asserted the local topology, not the product: readiness from a different origin to the page, and the constant version 'v0.1.0'. Fixed in the suite (f78095c).
browser.second_run: 17 passed, 0 skipped, 1.4 min — including the 10 that need the real Waterloo network or place index

route_latency.what: One journey (the smoke journey, wheelchair profile), each request a new HTTPS connection. server_computation_ms is the sum of the two routes' own computation_ms. One worker.
route_latency.reading: One process computes about seven route comparisons a second; four clients queue behind each other. Not a capacity or service-level figure.

backup.schedule: systemd timer daily 07:15 UTC, plus before every deploy and production restore
backup.retention: 14 days, never fewer than three files

scratch_restore.checks: revision 0007, 155,714 nodes, 180,554 segments, 33,225 place entries, 3 sealed-dataset triggers, pathable_app not a superuser

production_restore.outage_from_outside: readiness unavailable for about 89 s across 2-s samples; the landing page answered 200 throughout (72 of 72 samples)

forward.to: 465bab7929717fddacb90fcd726ac5bd8d7d320b (the previous merge on main, same migration head 0007)

rollback.from_outside: per switch, routing unavailable for about 55 s (502 while the old process exited, then 503 and 5-s timeouts while the graph loaded), and the landing page 502 for two consecutive 2-s samples when its container was recreated
rollback.not_exercised: the refusal when the database is past the previous release's head: no release since 0007 changes the schema

reboot.from_outside: landing page answering again within 59 s of the reboot command and routing within 66 s, 2-s samples; nothing was started by hand
reboot.after: docker, fail2ban, ufw, swap and the backup timer active; all four containers healthy; smoke 16/16 from the host and from the laptop

faults_found_and_fixed: The API image could not start the `pathable` CLI: ImportError libexpat.so.1. The python:3.13-slim-bookworm base no longer carries libexpat1 now that Python bundles expat, and pyosmium links the system library. The server was unaffected. Fixed in services/api/Dockerfile; CI now starts the CLI inside the built image. The deployed a3f6448 images predate the fix, so checksums on this host ran in pathable-api-cli:<sha>, the release image plus libexpat1.
Caddy served no certificate to clients that send no SNI (see tls).
deploy.sh skipped its pre-deploy backup silently when the previous stack's compose.yaml no longer interpolated; it now reads the database directly and refuses to deploy without a backup.
Two full-stack browser assertions encoded the local topology (see browser).
